English Grammar: Modals (Advanced Notes & Tricks)

Modals (Modal Verbs) kya hote hain?

Modals aisi special helping verbs hoti hain jo main verb ke sath judkar bolne wale ka 'mood' ya 'attitude' batati hain (jaise: kshamta, anumati, salaah, ya majboori).

🔥 Golden Tricks (Common Mistakes se bachne ke liye) - Part 1:

1. The 'V1' Rule (Sabse badi trick): Modals ke baad hamesha Verb ki 1st form (Base form) aati hai.
• Sahi: He can go.
• Galat: He can goes / He can going / He can went.

2. The 'To' Rule: Modals ke theek baad kabhi 'to' nahi lagta (Sirf ought to aur used to ko chhod kar).
• Sahi: I must study.
• Galat: I must to study.

🔥 Golden Tricks - Part 2:

3. No 'S/ES' Rule: Subject chahe Singular ho (He/She/It) ya Plural (I/We/They), Modal ka roop kabhi nahi badalta.
• Sahi: She can sing.
• Galat: She cans sing.

4. Negative Trick: Modal aur Main Verb ke beech mein 'not' lagta hai. (Modal + not + V1).
• Example: You should not go there.

📚 Important Modals aur unke Uses - Part 1:

1. Can: Ability (Kshamta), Friendly Permission | Hindi trick: sakta hai (100% capacity)
• Example: I can lift 50 kg.

2. Could: Past Ability, Polite Request (Vinamrata) | Hindi trick: saka / paya / sakta tha
• Example: Could you help me, please?

📚 Important Modals aur unke Uses - Part 2:

3. May: Formal Permission (Office/School), Possibility | Hindi trick: shayad ho / sakta hai
• Example: May I come in? / It may rain.

4. Might: Very weak possibility (Na ke barabar sambhavna) | Hindi trick: shayad hi
• Example: He might pass the exam. (Umeed kam hai)

📚 Important Modals aur unke Uses - Part 3:

5. Should: Advice / Suggestion (Salaah) | Hindi trick: chahiye
• Example: You should sleep early.

6. Must: Compulsion / Strong Duty (Majboori/Zaroori) | Hindi trick: zaroor chahiye
• Example: You must wear a helmet.

📚 Important Modals aur unke Uses - Part 4:

7. Ought to: Moral Duty (Naitik Kartavya - Sanskaar) | Hindi trick: chahiye (farz ke liye)
• Example: We ought to respect our parents.

8. Would: Offer karna ya Past Habit batana | Hindi trick: karoge / karta tha
• Example: Would you like some coffee?

💡 Confusing Pairs (Inme humesha doubt hota hai) - Part 1:

May vs Might (Sambhavna):

• May: Agar baadal kaale hain, toh barish aane ke chance zyada hain: It may rain.

• Might: Agar aasmaan saaf hai, par fir bhi aap tukka laga rahe hain: It might rain.

💡 Confusing Pairs - Part 2:

Should vs Must vs Ought to (Chahiye):

• Should (Normal salaah): You should study. (Padhna chahiye)

• Must (Warning / Zaroori): Tomorrow is the exam, you must study. (Kal exam hai, zaroor padhna chahiye)

• Ought to (Duty): You ought to respect teachers. (Teachers ki izzat karni chahiye)
